services.title: Wedding Films
services.description: Timeless, emotion-driven wedding films documented with cinematic elegance, natural lighting, and intimate visual rhythm.
services.full_description: We treat every wedding as a sacred cinematic epic. Our signature documentary-meets-fine-art approach captures the nervous anticipation, the stolen glances, and the euphoric celebrations without staged clichés.

services.title: Commercial Ads
services.description: High-impact advertising films and brand manifestos engineered to command attention and inspire immediate brand loyalty.
services.full_description: From national television campaigns to digital social spectacles, we conceptualize, shoot, and post-produce high-fidelity commercials that translate brand narratives into unforgettable cultural moments.

services.title: Music Videos
services.description: Visually arresting music videos with hypnotic pacing, custom lighting design, and bold stylistic direction for visionary artists.
services.full_description: Collaborating directly with musical artists and record labels, we merge sonic frequency with striking visual worlds — experimenting with optical textures, anamorphic flares, and rhythmically synchronized cuts.

services.title: Documentaries
services.description: Deeply researched, character-driven feature and short documentaries exploring human triumph, art, and environmental wonder.
services.full_description: Our documentary division travels to the furthest corners of the globe to capture raw truth. We prioritize empathetic journalistic integrity combined with festival-grade cinematography.

projects.title: Elysian Vows — Florence & Michael
projects.short_description: A sun-drenched Tuscan villa ceremony captured on 35mm anamorphic glass and RED Monstro 8K.
projects.full_description: Set against the rolling golden hills of Val d'Orcia, Florence and Michael gathered friends and family for an intimate three-day celebration. Using customized anamorphic lenses and Kodak 250D emulation, Athul documented this union with romantic warmth, rich shadow tones, and sweeping architectural aerial perspectives.

projects.title: Apex Velocity — Nocturne GT Campaign
projects.short_description: High-speed precision tracking film across neon-soaked Tokyo expressway tunnels.
projects.full_description: Commissioned to launch the new limited hypercar concept, we utilized a custom gyro-stabilized Russian Arm camera chase vehicle to film high-speed midnight runs through Tokyo's Shuto expressway system. Precision color timed with heavy contrast and metallic amber hues.

projects.title: Neon Reverie — The Midnight Pulse
projects.short_description: A hallucinatory synthwave odyssey combining anamorphic flares with practical in-camera optical illusions.
projects.full_description: An ambitious 5-minute visual narrative filmed in an abandoned industrial cathedral. We deployed synchronized DMX-controlled lighting rigs synchronized to the audio track's sub-bass frequencies, creating an immersive cyber-noir visual landscape.

projects.title: Silent Peaks — Himalayan Solitude
projects.short_description: An intimate exploration of monasteries perched 14,000 feet above the clouds in Ladakh.
projects.full_description: Filmed over four weeks in sub-zero alpine conditions, Silent Peaks follows Buddhist monks preserving centuries-old manuscript chanting traditions. Captured in natural sunlight and flickering butter lamps with extreme dynamic range.

projects.title: Vogue Noir — Haute Couture Runway
projects.short_description: Paris Fashion Week high-speed phantom flex cinematography showcasing avant-garde textile physics.
projects.full_description: Filmed at 1,000 frames per second using high-output tungsten lighting, this fashion piece breaks down micro-movements of silk, metallic weaves, and structural pleats on the runway for Maison Noir.

projects.title: Golden Horizons — Desert Shadows
projects.short_description: Medium-format architectural and editorial portrait series under Arabian dune sunsets.
projects.full_description: A fine-art photographic monograph exploring the interplay of minimalist modern concrete architecture against the fluid organic curves of shifting sand dunes in Liwa Desert.

projects.title: The Classical Form & Sculptural Murals — Fine Art Works
projects.short_description: Life-size figurative sculptures, terracotta Harappan reliefs, and environmental installations created by Athul Ollur.
projects.full_description: With a BFA from Raja Ravi Varma College of Fine Arts and experience at RestoreDesign Bangalore, Athul has created striking life-size sculptures (including a signature outdoor mermaid statue in Kerala), architectural reliefs inspired by Indus Valley civilization bulls, and dynamic figurative studies in clay, plaster, and bronze-effect finishes.

projects.title: Chiaroscuro & Human Soul — Canvas Paintings & Aquatint Etchings
projects.short_description: A fine art collection spanning oil on canvas, watercolor still lifes, and intaglio aquatint etchings.
projects.full_description: A curated selection of Athul Ollur's fine art paintings and printmaking pieces. Featuring dramatic chiaroscuro oil works (traditional terracotta vessel carrier on crimson canvas, meditative ascetics), expressive portraits, intricate floral aquatint etchings, and luminous watercolors demonstrating his foundational mastery of tone and texture.
projects.client: Raja Ravi Varma Fine Arts Portfolio

projects.title: Scenography & Event Architecture — Grand Stage Installations
projects.short_description: Architectural event scenography, grand stage lighting, and custom thematic set designs.
projects.full_description: Merging art direction with spatial engineering, Athul designs immersive stage experiences, carved architectural arches, theatrical lighting palettes, and sculptural decor for high-end wedding events and cultural showcases.

about_content.heading: ATHUL OLLUR — CINEMATOGRAPHER & VISUAL ARTIST.
about_content.intro: Athul Ollur (Athul Kumar) is a multidisciplinary Director of Photography (DOP), Cinematographer, and Fine Arts Graduate (BFA in Painting from Raja Ravi Varma College of Fine Arts, Kerala University). His visual direction is shaped by a deep mastery of light, color harmony, and human emotion.
about_content.story:
Before looking through a camera viewfinder, Athul Ollur studied the masters of light on canvas. Holding a Bachelor of Fine Arts (BFA in Painting) from the historic Raja Ravi Varma College of Fine Arts, Mavelikkara (2015), and having worked as a sculptor at RestoreDesign Bangalore, his cinema aesthetic is anchored in classical painting, dimensional lighting, and spatial rhythm.

From 2016 onwards, Athul built a prolific independent career as a freelance videographer, cinematographer, photographer, and visual artist. He served as lead Cinematographer at Greenmedia (2023–2024), orchestrating commercial advertising campaigns and branded films, before becoming Director of Photography (DOP) at Skillmount Education (2024–2026), where he directs high-production-value video series, masterclasses, and visual narratives.

His work spans luxury destination weddings, commercial films, music videos, documentaries, and large-scale fine art sculptures and paintings across Kerala, Bangalore, and across India.
about_content.philosophy: To me, cinematography is painting with dynamic light across time. My fine arts background taught me that light is not merely illumination — it creates volume, texture, tension, and truth. Every camera movement must have rhythm, intent, and emotional honesty.
about_content.approach: Bridging fine art intuition with technical precision: tailored anamorphic and spherical lens choices, chiaroscuro lighting architecture, fine-tuned post-production across Final Cut Pro, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Edius, and Photoshop, with holistic art direction from concept sketch to final grade.

experience.description: Directing visual architecture, camera department, lighting setups, and cinematic execution for high-end educational video productions, masterclass series, and brand storytelling.
Spearheaded camera operation, visual branding campaigns, commercial advertisements, promotional films, and creative video content from pre-production to final delivery.
Leading camera, lighting, and creative direction across luxury wedding films, commercial adverts, music videos, documentaries, and fine art commissions.
Sculpted life-size figurative installations, environmental art pieces, and architectural reliefs in plaster, clay, and composite materials.
